records.title: CODO: An Automated Compiler for Comprehensive Dataflow Optimization
records.reason: CODO is a compiler for dataflow optimization on FPGA designs. Full text focuses on generic accelerator compilation and does not establish a transformer/LLM case study; lineage relation is therefore indirect.

records.title: DeCoVec: Building Decoding Space based Task Vector for Large Language Models via In-Context Learning
records.reason: DeCoVec constructs task vectors in decoding space via in-context learning for task adaptation. Its results concern adaptation quality, with no inference-cost or serving optimization.

records.title: Embracing Anisotropy: Turning Massive Activations into Interpretable Control Knobs for Large Language Models
records.reason: The paper identifies activation dimensions as semantic/domain detectors and steers selected activations for adaptation or jailbreak experiments. It studies interpretability and behavior rather than efficiency.
